Ryan, saw Trainual crossed 10,000 teams across 150-plus countries and is out front at Transform 2026.

I built a personalized signal play for Trainual off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trainual needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
